figures.caption: Figure 1. Cosine similarity visualization between word vectors and sentences with same meaning but different words/orders. It shows that sentences with the same meaning may pay more attention to different words.

Table 3. Comparison of different LLMs for query and gallery feature compensation on RSTPReid with IRRA baseline. The LLMs utilized, in sequential order, are Grok-3, DeepSeek-V3, GPT-4oMini, and Qwen2.5-VL-32B.
Figure 5. Visual comparison of top-10 retrieved results between IRRA(baseline) and our method. Green boxes indicate correct matches, while red boxes are incorrect ones.
Figure 6. T-sne visualizations of the baseline and ours method. The crosses represent query features and circles represent gallery features.
Figure 2. Overview of the proposed framework (MVR) for the text-to-image person retrieval, which is a training-free framework could be directly applied to different text-to-image retrieval tasks.

Table 1. Comparisons with state-of-the-art ReID methods under the traditional evaluation setting. Bold indicates performance improvement over the corresponding baseline. Gray highlight denotes the state-of-the-art result on that dataset.
